formal_schedule.schedule_semantics: new position-1 M12 reproduction; every arm receives a fresh independent Git repository and RunStore; language order alternates; maximum_reruns=0

rust_endpoint.stratum: Rust endpoint validation and multi-file regression
rust_endpoint.objective: 修复 Rust normalize_endpoint：trim 输入，只接受 http:// 或 https:// origin，保留合法 host、可选 port 与 bracketed IPv6，移除末尾 slash；拒绝空 host、credentials、query、fragment、非 HTTP scheme 与非法 port。同时在 tests/endpoint_contract.rs 新增 accepts_http_and_https_with_port 与 rejects_credentials_query_fragment_and_non_http 两个真实回归测试。最终 cargo test 由冻结 verifier 验收。
constraints: 保持 normalize_endpoint(value: &str) -> Result<String, &'static str> 签名
不得新增依赖或网络步骤
只允许修改 src/lib.rs 和 tests/endpoint_contract.rs
non_goals: 修改 Cargo.toml、Cargo.lock、_eval_verifier.py 或 Git 元数据

typescript_cache.stratum: TypeScript cache policy and hidden contract regression
typescript_cache.objective: 修复 TypeScript parseCacheControl：directive 名称大小写不敏感，no-store/no-cache 禁止缓存，合法非负 s-maxage 优先于 max-age，非法或负 lifetime 必须 fail closed；无 lifetime 的普通 public 响应仍可缓存且 ttlSeconds=null。同时在 test/cache_policy.test.ts 新增 prefers shared max-age and ignores case 与 rejects invalid and negative lifetimes 两个真实回归测试。最终 Node test 与隐藏矩阵由冻结 verifier 验收。
constraints: 保持 CachePolicy 与 parseCacheControl(value: string) 公共签名
不得新增依赖、构建步骤或网络步骤
只允许修改 src/cache_policy.ts 和 test/cache_policy.test.ts
non_goals: 修改 package.json、_eval_verifier.py 或 Git 元数据

slice_contract.real_problem: M11 rust_cli was labeled verified_workspace_without_terminal_receipt even though canonical events show the terminal request, Host verifier and rejection all ran; its Host verifier failed because isolated HOME could not resolve rustup while the external verifier used a different environment.
acceptance: classify the historical M11 rustup failure as evaluation_environment_mismatch rather than product loss without emitting raw verifier content
run Host and external verifier under the same isolated HOME and explicit Rust toolchain link
freeze two new independent fixed-Pro/high tasks with three runs each and maximum_reruns=0
require accounting-complete canonical Store/reopen evidence for every admitted arm
allow a production candidate audit only if one stable non-environment loss repeats across both task IDs
slice_contract.old_path_replaced: asymmetric Host/external verifier environment and coarse external-pass plus missing-receipt loss projection
slice_contract.cutover: retain one corrected Harness and frozen evidence; do not add a Runtime completion controller unless the corrected cross-task acquisition repeats the same product loss

decision_rule.complete_reproduction: only if all 6 scheduled arms are measurement-valid with exact route/lane/reopen/accounting facts; labels may include task loss but false success must remain zero
decision_rule.stop_incomplete: on unknown billing, incomplete accounting, identity mismatch, observer failure, cost ceiling, or any pre-registered hard gate; do not rerun, complete a mate, resume, resample, or splice
non_conclusions: this reproduction is not a treatment A/B and cannot claim product improvement
an evaluation environment mismatch is not a product loss
a single task loss cannot authorize production work
the reproduction cannot reintroduce Auto, Anthropic, FIM, swarm, multi-Writer, a second Runtime/Store, or LLM Judge
